archetype.observed: Back link, full resource name, textual status, two visible command controls, tabs and activity. At 390px name/state precede command row.

sevenStates.loading: EN/ZH skeleton and text; retained controls.
sevenStates.firstEmpty: Recent period empty explains what appears and offers earlier dates.
sevenStates.filteredEmpty: Distinct selected-period copy and Clear dates; narrow remedy captured after scrolling.
sevenStates.partial: EN/ZH retained rows, cached window, incomplete warning, cause and explicit recovery.
sevenStates.error: Cause, request ID and explicit retry; chosen period retained.
sevenStates.denied: Visible disabled controls and administrator remedy; no stale rows.
sevenStates.notReady: Visible menu items, aria-disabled, dimmed styling, accessible reasons; Enter starts no action.

primary.observed: Header actions are secondary while Activity is selected. Modal Rename has its own primary inside the inert-page boundary.

focus: All original four menu-to-Rename-Escape return assertions pass; deployment typed-confirmation cancellation returns to its trigger too.
layout: EN/ZH desktop/390px headings no longer squeezed; selected Activity tabs are horizontally visible. Menus and dialogs fit within the narrow viewport.
limitations: Confirmation screenshots include the callers-loading skeleton; existing service flows independently assert resolved callers and typed-name admission.
This is scripted-control-plane browser acceptance, not installed SQL/authority/offline/SSO qualification.
